dish.title: Swiss Raclette Night: Melted Raclette over Potatoes with Cornichons and Pickled Onions
dish.description: A home version of the Valais classic: slices of raclette cheese melted under the broiler until bubbling and blistered, scraped over hot boiled new potatoes, and eaten with cornichons, pickled pearl onions, and a crisp green salad with mustard vinaigrette.

recipe_version.title: Swiss Raclette Night: Melted Raclette over Potatoes with Cornichons and Pickled Onions
recipe_version.description: A home version of the Valais classic: slices of raclette cheese melted under the broiler until bubbling and blistered, scraped over hot boiled new potatoes, and eaten with cornichons, pickled pearl onions, and a crisp green salad with mustard vinaigrette.

ingredients.name: raclette cheese
ingredients.display_name: raclette cheese whose label lists microbial rennet

ingredients.name: cornichons
ingredients.display_name: cornichons whose label lists cucumbers, vinegar, salt, and spices only

ingredients.name: pickled pearl onions
ingredients.display_name: pickled pearl onions whose label lists onions, vinegar, salt, and spices only

steps.title: Prep
steps.body: Scrub the potatoes. Trim the rind from the raclette and slice it 1/4 inch thick. Tear the lettuce. Shake the Dijon, vinegar, and olive oil in a jar.

steps.title: Boil the potatoes
steps.body: Put the potatoes in a 6-quart pot with 10 cups water and 1 tbsp salt. Bring to a boil over high heat, about 12 minutes, then cook until tender, about 18 minutes. Drain and keep covered.

steps.title: Set the table
steps.body: While the potatoes boil, put the cornichons and pickled onions in bowls and dress the lettuce (overlap stated).

steps.title: Preheat the broiler
steps.body: Preheat the broiler on high for 5 minutes with a rack 6 inches below the element.

steps.title: Melt the cheese
steps.body: Lay the cheese slices in a single layer on a parchment-lined sheet pan (or in 4 small oven-safe dishes) and broil until melted, bubbling, and blistered in spots, 2 to 4 minutes.

steps.title: Serve
steps.body: Halve the hot potatoes onto plates, scrape the molten cheese over them, and season with pepper and a pinch of paprika. Serve at once with the cornichons, pickled onions, and salad.

equipment: rimmed sheet pan or 4 small oven-safe dishes
small jar or bowl for vinaigrette
